description: KMZ于1960年推出的旁轴相机。配备Industar-58。快门速度FXCh-18 central leaf shutter, speed: 1-1/500 +B, very quiet, possible to set separately.。使用roll 120 film, picture size 6x6cm。Yellow rangefinder images must be matched in the viewfinder for exact focus, via focusing ring w/ grooved silver handle, behind the lens-shutter barrel。
